build_adam_compressor: build a python module that creates an AdamCompressor instance to quantize a PyTorch model using AdamW optimizer
create_quantized_model: create a quantized PyTorch model by instantiating AdamCompressor with a model and W4A16 scheme
configure_optimizer: configure the AdamCompressor optimizer by passing a string name or torch.optim class to the constructor
review_get_optimizer: review the AdamCompressor _get_optimizer method that resolves optimizer strings to torch.optim classes
review_get_scaler: review the AdamCompressor _get_scaler method that returns a GradScaler for mixed precision training
